name: CADCraft
cost: Free (MIT or Apache-2.0), no account and no subscription
works_with: macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD and the browser; AI agents through MCP or its CLI
short: An open source 2D and 3D CAD and drafting app in Rust that works the way AutoCAD users expect, with a command line agents can drive.
what: You type `L`, click two points, type `@5<45` and press Enter, and it behaves like the drafting tools you know: object snaps, polar tracking, grips, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks and layouts. It reads and writes DXF and opens and saves DWG through the open source acadrust library. Every menu item is also a command, so an agent can draw, inspect and render over MCP, a JSON channel or the CLI.
who: Drafters and engineers who want a free AutoCAD-style tool, and developers who want an agent to make or check drawings. It is in early development, so check the roadmap before relying on it for production work.
needs: A download for your system from the latest GitHub release
To build from source: Rust 1.95 or later

steps.title: Download a build
steps.text: Get the installer or portable build for your system from github.com/storytold/cadcraft/releases. Check that the owner is `storytold`, then compare the checksum with the line in the release's `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
steps.code:
shasum -a 256 cadcraft-<ver>-macos-universal.dmg     # macOS (on Linux: sha256sum FILE)
Get-FileHash .\cadcraft-<ver>-windows-x64.msi        # Windows PowerShell

steps.title: Or build it from source
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft
cd cadcraft
cargo run --release -p cadcraft -- --sample       # opens the sample drawing

steps.title: Draw something
steps.text: Type these at the command line.
steps.code:
line 0,0 @10,0 @0,5 c          a closed triangle
circle 5,2 1                    a circle
offset 0.25                     then pick the circle and a side
zoom e                          zoom to extents

steps.title: Connect your agent
steps.text: This runs an MCP server headless. To bridge it to the running app, start the app with `--control 7979` and use `cadcraft-cli mcp --connect 127.0.0.1:7979`.

steps.title: Convert or render without the app
steps.code:
cadcraft-cli info drawing.dxf
cadcraft-cli convert drawing.dxf drawing.svg

try.label: From the README
try.text: Draw a circle into the sample, save it and export a picture in one go: `cadcraft-cli run --sample --script 'CIRCLE 22,3 1\n' --save out.dxf --export out.png`.

watch: It is in early, fast development. Things it doesn't model yet are dropped when you save a DXF or DWG, so keep a copy of files you open.
The README warns to download only from the storytold/cadcraft releases and to check the checksum first.
On Windows the app uses DirectX 12 by default. If it won't open, the README shows how to try another backend with `WGPU_BACKEND`.
MCP tools connected to the app include `screenshot` and `ui_click`.
